questTitle: Run a Half Marathon on my 39th bday
statusStatement: Another interval-training session is reported completed toward the 20 November half marathon. Completion of this week's long run and two-run target is not established.
whatMattersNow: Establish whether this week's long run and two-run routine have been completed.
outcomeStatement: I will run a half marathon on 20 November 2026, my 39th birthday, while rebuilding a sustainable baseline of one long run and one interval run each week.
quote: The miracle isn't that I finished. The miracle is that I had the courage to start.

statusStatement: The fence was previously recorded as complete, and a driveway quote has been requested. Quote receipt or acceptance, driveway construction, gate installation, overkapping, and carport ground completion remain unconfirmed.

outcomeStatement: I will create a finished functional outdoor area with the fence and gate installed, an overkapping built, and the driveway and carport ground completed.
quote: Great things are done by a series of small things brought together.

statusStatement: Bike hangers have been installed and the bikes hung, adding to previously reported TV and speaker mounting. Lighting, electrical finishing, ventilation, audiovisual testing, and future rower space remain unconfirmed or outstanding.

outcomeStatement: I will create a finished, clean Zwift-focused garage gym with working TV, sound, electrics, ventilation, lighting, and room for a future rower.
quote: Strength does not come from physical capacity. It comes from an indomitable will.

statusStatement: A materials pickup is reported, but the items are unspecified. No installation or finishing task is newly confirmed complete, and the availability of the awaited furniture and wall plates is not established.

outcomeStatement: I will finish the downstairs toilet as a fully usable, intentional space with ventilation, lighting, finished walls, niche, shelf, handwashing furniture, and clean details.
quote: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

statusStatement: Today's food and drink report does not establish a calorie surplus or body-fat setback. Sustained six-hour training weeks and progress toward 12% body fat cannot be assessed without Workouts totals and a new Withings measurement.
whatMattersNow: Assess weekly training and body-fat progress using Workouts totals and a new Withings measurement.
outcomeStatement: I will sustain at least six hours of weekly training recorded in Workouts and reduce body fat from about 16% to 12% using my Withings Body Scan.
quote: Take care of your body. It's the only place you have to live.
